cues.zh: 徒手攀岩这项运动很好理解。他没带绳子就爬上了那块巨大的岩壁。一旦失手，就是死亡。
cues.en: The sport of free-soloing is easy to understand. He went up this giant base without a rope. If he falls, he dies.

cues.zh: 我多年前就听说过，就像这里的高难度山路，那种又大又难的multi-pitch，堪称试金石。
cues.en: I’d heard about it years ago, it was like the hard mountain route down here, the big, hard multi-pitch that was like the test piece.

cues.zh: 对我来说，它一直代表着技术攀登的下一步。
cues.en: I mean, it’s always just represented the next step in technical climbing to me.

cues.zh: 可能太吓人了，但我要投入大量精力，弄清楚它到底可不可行。
cues.en: It might be too scary, but I’m going to put a bunch of work into it and kind of figure out whether or not it’s even possible.

cues.zh: 帮朋友去做一件你知道可能害死他的事，感觉挺怪的。
cues.en: It’s just kind of weird helping your friend do something that you know could potentially lead to his death.

cues.zh: 好了。出发日。
cues.en: Alright. Up day.

cues.zh: 稍微清理一下路线，拔掉一些植被，先摸一摸底。
cues.en: Cleaning the route a little bit, pulling off some of the vegetation, and just sort of sussing it out a little bit.

cues.zh: 我一直想象自己没系绳子的样子，然后就会特别害怕。[轻笑]
cues.en: Kept on picturing myself without a rope and then I’d get really scared. [chuckles]

cues.zh: 目前这条路线的徒手攀爬条件怎么样？
cues.en: How’s the condition of the route currently for soloing?

cues.zh: 挺湿的。不太理想。
cues.en: Quite damp. It’s sub optimal.

cues.zh: 我是说，你只要抓住一个小支点，它从墙上脱落，你就摔死了，你懂的。
cues.en: I mean, all it takes is you grab one small hold and it pops off the wall and you fall to your death, you know.

cues.zh: 所以我帮Alex清理墙面的时候，我就在想，我要把每个小地方都清理干净，你知道吧。
cues.en: So when I was cleaning the wall for Alex, I was like I’m cleaning every little things, you know.

cues.zh: 我想着任何看起来松动的东西，或者任何一小块脏东西，我都要试着从墙上清理掉，
cues.en: I was like anything that looked loose or any little piece of dirt I was trying to clean it off the wall,

cues.zh: 因为我显然希望我的朋友活下来。
cues.en: because I obviously want my buddy to live.

cues.zh: 你是不是感觉有点打滑？
cues.en: Do you feel like you’re slipping a little?

cues.zh: 这有点像是“谢天谢地”的时刻，对吧？
cues.en: It’s a bit of a ‘thank God’ moment, right?

cues.zh: 嗯，有一点吧。
cues.en: Well, a little bit.

cues.zh: 那天某个时候，我和Cedar在上面的时候，我就想，我准备好了，我厌倦了在绳子上晃来晃去。
cues.en: At some point during the day while I was up there with Cedar I was just like I’m ready, like I’m sick of hanging around on ropes.

cues.zh: 它从一种有点吓人的想法，变成了，我挺兴奋去做这件事的。
cues.en: It went from, like, being sort of an intimidating idea to just being, like, I’m kind of excited to do this.

cues.zh: 现在我们来看看上面会发生什么，不过……
cues.en: Now we’re going to see, see what happens up there, but…

cues.zh: 又是美好的一天。
cues.en: Another good day.

cues.zh: 有人出去过吗，外面怎么样？
cues.en: Has anybody stepped outside, how is it?

cues.zh: 挺凉的，今天更冷一些，
cues.en: It’s cool, it’s a little more chilly today,

cues.zh: 还有点儿微风。
cues.en: and it’s a slight breeze.
